# ontolint

> An offline ontology-quality linter for RDF, OWL, SKOS and SHACL. It reads ontology files, reports findings with a rule id, severity, focus, message, suggestion and confidence, and exits 0 (no finding reached --fail-on), 1 (findings) or 2 (tool failure). Python 3.13+, Apache-2.0, on PyPI as `ontolint`. Findings are review prompts, not proofs of inconsistency. The project is Alpha: pin a version.

Install and run: `uv tool install ontolint`, then `ontolint ontology.ttl`. Machine-readable output: `--format json` (key `schema_version`, currently 1) or `--format sarif` (SARIF 2.1.0); `ontolint --list-rules --format json` lists every rule; `ontolint --explain RULE_ID` explains one.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/arnaudgelas/ontolint/blob/main/README.md): quick start, every option, policy and baselines, input formats, input safety, limitations.
- [Rule reference](https://github.com/arnaudgelas/ontolint/blob/main/docs/rules.md): the index of every rule, linking one page per family (`docs/rules/<family>.md`) that gives each rule's severity, its specification and every failing and clean test case, with the message reported for each failing case that runs on a graph. Generated from the catalogue.
- [Rule catalogue](https://github.com/arnaudgelas/ontolint/blob/main/src/ontolint/data/rule_catalogue.csv): the machine-readable source of the rule list.

## Reference

- [Command-line and report features](https://github.com/arnaudgelas/ontolint/blob/main/docs/cli-features.md): the reporting and execution features that are not lint rules.

- [Performance](https://github.com/arnaudgelas/ontolint/blob/main/docs/performance.md): resource budgets and benchmarks.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/arnaudgelas/ontolint/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): releases, with upgrade notes.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/arnaudgelas/ontolint/blob/main/SECURITY.md): supported versions and how to report a vulnerability.
